items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: Oh well none of them were like Stan Getz or Zoot Sims, you know big names.

ctx.x: The other saxophone players that you were playing with.

Oh well none of them were like Stan Getz or Zoot Sims, you know big names. But they were pretty good players. I was spoiled because my father introduced me to so many musicians and I heard him play all the time, he was always a soloist and you could catch him on the radio playing with bands and things. And so it was natural for me. It wasn’t an overwhelming kind of pressure. I didn’t feel that way about it. In fact if anything I knew the weaknesses, musical weaknesses of Woody Herman’s band before I ever joined…
I see. That’s an interesting attitude. Did the musicians have nicknames?
